CREATE TABLE world_credentials (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	thinking_level VARCHAR(8), 
	encrypted_secret TEXT, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(32), 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	aad_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	aad_purpose VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(world_character_id, world_id) REFERENCES world_characters (id, world_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(world_id) REFERENCES worlds (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_world_credential_revision CHECK (revision >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_world_credential_purpose CHECK (purpose IN ('sns','image','chat','vision','consolidation','embedding')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_world_credential_purpose UNIQUE (owner_id, world_id, world_character_id, purpose)
)


CREATE TABLE world_image_attempts (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	request_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	period_date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	lane VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	credential_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_world_image_attempt_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','submitted','completed','failed','unknown','released')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_world_image_attempt_request UNIQUE (world_character_id, purpose, request_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(world_character_id) REFERENCES world_characters (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_world_image_attempt_purpose CHECK (purpose IN ('image','vision'))
)

CREATE INDEX ix_world_image_attempts_world_character_id ON world_image_attempts (world_character_id)

CREATE TABLE world_image_policies (
	world_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	generation_limit INTEGER, 
	vision_limit INTEGER, 
	generation_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	vision_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	generation_settings JSON NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	provenance VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (world_character_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_world_image_policy_revision CHECK (revision >= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(world_character_id) REFERENCES world_characters (id)
)


CREATE TABLE memory_index_preparations (
	scope_setting_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	profile VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	source_generation VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	credential_revision INTEGER, 
	request_key VARCHAR(128), 
	cursor VARCHAR(64), 
	last_code VARCHAR(80), 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_setting_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_setting_id) REFERENCES memory_scope_settings (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_memory_index_preparation_state CHECK (state IN ('needs_preparation','running','ready','error'))
)


CREATE TABLE memory_subject_profiles (
	scope_setting_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	model_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	thinking_level VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_setting_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_setting_id) REFERENCES memory_scope_settings (id)
)


CREATE TABLE world_credential_revisions (
	credential_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	thinking_level VARCHAR(8), 
	encrypted_secret TEXT, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(32), 
	aad_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	aad_purpose VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (credential_id, revision), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_world_credential_history_revision CHECK (revision >= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(credential_id) REFERENCES world_credentials (id)
)


CREATE TABLE memory_episode_restrictions (
	memory_item_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	thread_id VARCHAR(64), 
	sources_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	priors_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (memory_item_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_memory_episode_restriction_mode CHECK (mode IN ('public','private_thread')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(memory_item_id) REFERENCES memory_items (id)
)
